description: Exact per-source RFC-0165 fixture contracts. The production freeze fails closed until every discovered source has a reviewed entry.

fixture_kinds.runnable-deterministic: Run check and the ordinary production CLI; the merged process stream is a runtime observation.
fixture_kinds.library: Run check only; no runtime compatibility claim is made.
fixture_kinds.external: Run check only; the unavailable external host fixture remains an explicit gap.
fixture_kinds.runnable-nondeterministic: Run check only until an explicit replayable input/environment domain exists.
fixture_kinds.intentionally-invalid: Run check only and require rejection.
